what: Clicking a same-site link makes an accent-colored curtain fill from bottom to top in .7s (clip-path inset, power2.inOut), a dark curtain inside it comes up .1s later and the center logo comes up from 30px below .2s later, and then it navigates. The new page opens covered by the curtain, rests .5s, then the logo slips 30px up, the dark curtain lifts first and the accent curtain lifts upward .1s later — a two-layer curtain that covers from below and lifts upward. fx:curtain-open fires .3s after lifting starts (.8s after the document opens), turning on the entrance motion at that point

options.dur: Length of one curtain (seconds), default .7 — shorten for apps that are flipped often
options.each: Gap between the two phases (s), default .1
options.delay: Pause before walking on the incoming page (s), default .5
options.lift: Distance the logo moves up and down (px), default 30

use: — Since the document changes on this site, the arriving page opening while covered is carried over with sessionStorage

from.where: shared.js page transition curtain (blue curtain + dark curtain + logo) — original Next.js transition leave/enter
